objective: Synthesize a path-sensitive memory_leak detector that encodes the same local state, guards, and lifecycle mechanism evidenced by the patch, while still generalizing to semantically equivalent sites.

trigger_invariants: a resource is allocated or acquired
a feasible exit path leaves the scope without releasing or transferring ownership
silence_invariants: all relevant exit paths release, transfer, or intentionally retain ownership
patch-added cleanup paths or defer-style release blocks the leak
patch-introduced cleanup or ownership-transfer logic covers all relevant exit paths
transfer_axes: equivalent allocation and cleanup contracts across sibling helpers
equivalent early-return cleanup omissions on adjacent paths
equivalent guard or barrier predicates on sibling paths
equivalent local state transitions around the same sink or dereference
equivalent ownership or release/reinit lifecycle on the same symbolic resource
forbidden_shortcuts: bind the detector to fixed file paths, line numbers, or exact patch strings
broaden into unrelated bug families just to improve hit count
report every allocation without checking ownership handoff
treat any free in the function as proof that all paths are safe
placeholder helper logic or empty ProgramState modeling

constraints.title: Generalize beyond patch site

constraints.title: Stay within proven mechanism scope

constraints.title: Honor mechanism contract
constraints.description: Preserve the mechanism family `resource_lifetime_leak` by keeping trigger invariants a resource is allocated or acquired; a feasible exit path leaves the scope without releasing or transferring ownership.

constraints.title: Generalize only on contract axes
constraints.description: Reuse semantics only along these transfer axes: equivalent allocation and cleanup contracts across sibling helpers; equivalent early-return cleanup omissions on adjacent paths; equivalent guard or barrier predicates on sibling paths.

constraints.title: Respect patched silence

constraints.title: Require an escaping unreleased path

constraints.title: Use path-sensitive evidence
